guidanceConsulted.query: responsive reference documentation tables without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Lean on intrinsic sizing; wrap potentially-wide content in overflow containers; overflow-wrap on unbreakable tokens; flex-wrap for wrapping rows.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: every data table sits in .table-wrap{overflow-x:auto}; overflow-wrap:anywhere on h1, lede, code, and table cells; <wbr> in the ProfilerSample.marker H1; baseline-browsers list uses flex-wrap; pre blocks scroll internally. Exception: no container queries — the shared single-column editorial measure already fits the reference format (same as prior accepted pages).

guidanceConsulted.query: embedding third-party iframe demo lazy loading performance
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Deprioritize non-critical embedded resources; use native lazy-loading for below-the-fold images and iframes so they do not compete with critical content.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: the showcase demo iframe is below the fold in the Examples section and carries loading="lazy" with explicit width/height to reserve layout space (no CLS from late load).

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible code blocks and syntax examples in documentation pages
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use semantic HTML structures (pre/code for code, real tables with header cells, descriptive link text, iframe titles) so assistive tech gets the same structure sighted readers do.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied: all examples are semantic <pre><code>; tables use thead/th scope=row; the embedded iframe has a descriptive title; citation links name their target rather than 'here'.

openQuestions: The ChromeStatus record's ot_description says marker exposure is 'gated on cross-origin isolation for non-script activity', which reads as if script were exposed without isolation — the spec PR's filter algorithm says the opposite (script is suppressed without isolation; only style/layout pass). The pages document the spec PR's normative model and quote the record's ongoing-constraints text (script/gc/paint permanently gated), but Chrome's exact trial-time behavior for the 'script' value in non-isolated contexts with an OT token should be runtime-verified.

Whether Chrome's origin-trial token widens the non-isolated marker set (the PR explicitly permits an OT opt-in to do so) or only turns the feature on, leaving the isolation split intact, is not stated anywhere fetched; needs runtime verification with a real token.

The ChromeStatus record carries web_feature '4217' with is_official_web_feature true, but webstatus.dev has no js-self-profiling-markers entry; the banner says so — recheck once web-features publishes an entry.
The wpt.fyi aligned Chrome 155 run records no result for the tentative marker test while Edge 155 passes 1/1; expected for an experimental-gated feature, but worth rechecking as the trial progresses.

The embedded showcase iframe (marker-field-probe) is HEAD 200 but its live rendering inside the page could not be exercised in this sandbox (headless Chrome has no external network here); a networked verification pass should confirm the demo composites inside the iframe on both viewport classes.
